mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_refund_log(order_id, order_sn, user_id, reason, refund_amount, status, create_time, update_time) VALUES(#{orderId}, #{orderSn}, #{userId}, #{reason}, #{refundAmount}, #{status}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE t_refund_log SET status = #{status}, admin_remark = #{adminRemark}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM t_refund_log WHERE order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM t_refund_log WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT * FROM t_refund_log ORDER BY create_time DESC
